“I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I…
Yahweh says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears; for your work will be rewarded,” says Yahweh.…
For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

translations.web: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”
translations.bsb: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”
translations.kjv: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
translations.asv: And he washed his face, and came out; and he refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
